description: This file defines UI layout elements, constants, and parameters for a confirmation UI in an Android project, including labels, buttons, font styles, and layout configurations.

classes.name: teeui::IconShield
classes.description: A label element representing a shield icon used in the confirmation UI.

classes.name: teeui::LabelTitle
classes.description: A label element for the title text in the confirmation UI.

classes.name: teeui::IconOk
classes.description: A button element representing the OK or confirm button.

classes.name: teeui::LabelOK
classes.description: A label for the OK confirmation button.

classes.name: teeui::LabelCancel
classes.description: A label for the cancel button.

classes.name: teeui::LabelHint
classes.description: A label providing a description or hint in the confirmation UI.

classes.name: teeui::LabelBody
classes.description: A label containing the main body text of the confirmation dialog.

classes.name: teeui::ConfUILayout
classes.description: A layout grouping all UI elements for the confirmation dialog.
